problem_statement: The radd/book-template project is a static Polish book portal ("Czytelnia") served directly over HTTP (index.html home with a book grid and popular reviews, book.html detail page, review pages, contact page) sharing one header/navigation, a local cover-image library under images/covers, review avatars, and no build step. Add a new cross-page Reading circles finder: a reading-circles.html page built from the site's existing book-card/section design system that presents the reading circles as a filterable card grid — a row of category tabs (Wszystkie / Fantastyka / Realizm / Kryminał) above the cards, and a live result-count readout that reads "Pokazano N z 6 · <Kategoria>". Clicking a category tab must filter the visible circle cards AND recompute the readout from the cards actually shown. Register a 'Reading circles' entry in the shared navigation registry (js/site-nav.js) so the nav-link renders consistently on the home page and the new page. Ground every reading circle in a real book and local cover already on the site; preserve the original navigation, hero, book grid, reviews, footer, local image paths, scripts, and responsive static behavior.
required_content: Add a new reading-circles.html page reachable over HTTP, using the existing shared header/nav, hero band, centered section headings, white card treatment and mint accent — not a detached framework.

The page must present at least six Reading circles cards built from the shared book-card pattern, each with a visible circle heading, a category label, a real local cover image from images/covers, and a short description grounded in an actual book on the site (Kamienie na szaniec, Harry Potter, Był sobie pies, Naznaczeni śmiercią, Mitologia nordycka, Quidditch przez wieki).

Add a category filter above the grid: tabs Wszystkie / Fantastyka / Realizm / Kryminał plus a live result-count readout reading "Pokazano N z 6 · <Kategoria>". Clicking a tab must filter the shown circle cards and recompute the readout from the cards actually displayed (e.g. Realizm -> "Pokazano 2 z 6 · Realizm").

Register a 'Reading circles' entry in the shared navigation registry js/site-nav.js so an Reading circles renders in the shared menu on BOTH the home page and the new reading-circles page (cross-page design-system continuity).
Reuse real local repo cover images (images/covers/*.jpg) for the circle cards; do not substitute generated placeholders, remote screenshots, or data URIs.

Keep the original site information architecture intact across pages: header navigation, home hero, book grid, popular reviews, signup, book.html detail sections, and the 2017 @Piotr Radziszewski footer.

Use only existing static surfaces (new .html page + a scoped stylesheet + js/site-nav.js + a small filter script); do not add a package manager, build step, backend, remote API, or new external dependency.
Keep desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures free of horizontal overflow, with the filter tabs and Reading circles cards stacking cleanly on mobile, and keep the runtime console/network clean.
design_constraints: This is a design-system/content continuity task: the new page must read as a native extension of the book portal, reusing the shared header/nav registry and the site's card/section rhythm.
The category filter is a real, working control: the visible cards and the "Pokazano N z 6" readout must both reflect the selected category after a click, not a frozen snapshot.
The nav-link must be a real, registered, cross-page menu entry (nav-link class) — not a one-off hard-coded anchor only on the new page.
The card grid and filter tab row must stay legible and non-overlapping: no shingled/colliding cards and no near-invisible low-contrast text.
Required labels must be real visible text in structural elements, not hidden benchmark text, alt-only strings, console logs, or metadata attributes.
Do not build a bespoke off-system page (inline cheatsheet header, ad-hoc rows) that ignores the shared chrome and design system.
Preserve the original covers, avatars, and page content; the verifier expects them to remain browser-visible across captured states.
state_constraints: The Reading circles page, its filter tabs, and its circle cards must render on reading-circles.html on desktop and mobile.
Clicking the Realizm tab on desktop must filter the grid and update the readout to "Pokazano 2 z 6 · Realizm".
The shared nav-link 'Reading circles' must render on the home page and the new page in the reference solution.
No responsive state should show horizontal overflow beyond the configured tolerance.

change_completion: reading-circles.html renders at least six shared-pattern circle cards with visible headings, local covers, and grounded descriptions.
The category filter tabs and the "Pokazano N z 6" readout work: clicking a tab filters the cards and recomputes the count/label from what is shown.
The 'Reading circles' nav-link is registered in js/site-nav.js and renders cross-page on Home and the new page.
regression: Original navigation, home hero, book grid, reviews, book detail sections, local image paths, scripts, and footer remain available across pages.
The site still serves directly over HTTP without a build step.
design_consistency: New UI uses the existing shared header/nav, centered headings, white cards, mint accent, and section spacing.
The filter tab row and card grid read as a native section of the book portal, non-overlapping and legible, not a generic benchmark panel or a colliding pile.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states have no horizontal overflow.
The filter tabs and circle cards collapse into legible stacked rows on mobile.

scoring_notes: A correct patch adds one reading-circles.html page built from the shared book-card/section design system with a working category filter (tabs + live "Pokazano N z 6 · <Kategoria>" readout that filters the grid and recomputes on click) and registers a cross-page 'Reading circles' nav-link in js/site-nav.js, grounding each circle in a real book and local cover. A solution that omits the nav registry (no cross-page nav-link), lets the filter tabs/cards overflow or collapse into an overlapping illegible pile, or wires the filter so the click registers but the readout stays frozen at "Pokazano 6 z 6 · Wszystkie" and the grid never filters, should not pass.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: radd/book-template is a runnable multi-page static book portal with a shared header/nav, a local cover-image library, reviews, and no build step, making it a good L4 Consistency add task: a new filterable Reading-circles finder (category tabs + result-count readout) plus a registered cross-page shared nav-link, exercising layout, cross-page continuity, and interaction.
